summary: Solana Co filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to register a direct offering of 3,076,922 shares of Class A common stock at $2.60 per share, raising approximately $8 million. The offering is a routine shelf takedown under an S-3 shelf registration statement, not a special situation. It is a standard equity financing with no special structural features. The stock trades on Nasdaq. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes as described in the prospectus. No board recommendation, advisors, or unusual terms are stated. The delivery is scheduled for April 28, 2026. This filing does not represent a corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
